prompt: Register the VPN App Container and its VPN-only application execution boundary. Apply after resolving the existing canonical package/aggregate mismatch.

node.dcterms:title: VPN App Container
node.dcterms:description: Container copies of designated apps use a default-deny firewall, IPv6 blocking and an unprivileged app UID. A root supervisor checks VPN connectivity and kills the application process group on failure. qBittorrent and Transmission presets; real Linux VPN verification required before security claims.
node.robos:technology: Electron / Vanilla JavaScript / Python / Docker / OpenVPN / iptables
